name: Cotton TLR
positioning: Specialized's 320 TPI cotton-casing tubeless-ready race tire.
caveats: Specialized labels it 'Racing Only': a race-day tire with less protection than its training tires.
The lab rating Specialized cites is not recorded here because the test itself was not read.

origin.basis: Specialized Bicycle Components, Inc. publishes the US store, with California consumer disclosures in the page footer.

manufacturing.basis: Specialized does not state where the tire is made.

availability.note: Sold by Specialized's US store; Specialized dealers in other regions were not checked in this pass.

price_observations.conditions: Official store price on 2026-11-01; one tire; shipping and tax at checkout.

image.shown: 700x28C tan-wall Cotton TLR as shown in Specialized's product photo.
image.alt: Specialized Cotton TLR road tire with tan sidewalls, standing upright

rights.usage_note: The maker's own product photo, shown from the maker's website; no copy is stored or redistributed by this project, and no license is asserted.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Coded on 2026-11-04 from a fixed source set: the written reviews on the Sigma Sports and bike-components product pages, read in full through each page's own review list (the newest 15 per page when more exist), every reader comment on Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test pages for this tire, and owner comments in coded Xiaohongshu threads. Counted only owners who describe their own riding; star-only ratings, reviews without riding detail, mounting-only impressions and repeats were left out. Comments on one construction's test page count for that construction unless the owner names the other. The earlier Turbo Cotton is not counted.

reports.summary: Fast and surprisingly robust: no mark on the tread after over 500 km of poor roads, with excellent comfort.
Fast and supple; impressive after the Corsa Pro.
Ridden in 30 mm since early spring with no punctures and no problems.
